title.narrative: UNHCR Enhanced sustainability for refugees in Lebanon
UNHCR Stärkt hållbarhet för flyktingar i Libanon

description.narrative: För att ’stärka kapacitet i Libanon för en hållbar situation för flyktingar och värdsamhällen’ (strategimål 3.3 i den regionala Syrienkrisstrategin 2024 – 2026) har Sida i samarbete med UNHCR utvecklat en flerårig insats som ämnar långsiktigt stärka syriska flyktingars inkludering och skydd, samt motverka spänningar mellan flyktingar och lokalsamhällen. Insatsen ska främja inkludering av syriska flyktingar i Libanon genom ett fokus på registrering, dokumentation, och juridiskt stöd; stärka skyddsmiljön genom investeringar i s.k. 'case management'; och motverka lokala spänningar genom småskaliga infrastrukturprojekt i lokalsamhällen som tagit emot stort antal flyktingar.

The project responds to the increasing need for targeted protection and assistance of Syrian refugees in Lebanon while promoting an enabling legal and protection environment, supporting a peaceful coexistence of refugees and host communities. Registration and civil documentation are crucial for enabling refugees to realize their rights, as it ensures access to legal residency and reduces the risk of arrest and deportation. The absence of legal status limits access to employment, education, and healthcare. Moreover, bureaucratic obstacles in obtaining or renewing residency further impede their access to essential services, leaving them in a precarious position. With the increasingly challenging environment, refugees with specific needs, children and GBV survivors will benefit from individual case management, to help them avoid having to resort to harmful coping strategies. These individual approaches are completed by the longer-term community support projects designed to transition from emergency aid to sustainable development by strengthening local infrastructure and services in areas heavily impacted by the refugee crisis.

The intervention aims to strengthen the long-term sustainability of the situation for Syrian refugees in Lebanon by promoting and enabling their formal inclusion, strengthening the protection environment, and supporting peaceful coexistence between refugees and host communities. Through a focus on registration and civil documentation, capacity building of case management infrastructure, and long-term development of social services and local institutions the programme aims to address the legal, bureaucratic, social and financial barriers forcing Syrian refugees to live in informality and marginalisation.
Whilst rooted in the humanitarian response, the contribution in question endeavours to take a resilience approach and acknowledging the protracted nature of the crisis.
The programme is divided into two outcome areas each with an overarching objective. These are as follows:
1. Access to registration and documentation: Accurate refugee data collected through registration centres is actively used to ensure equal and transparent access to protection and service provision and registration for Syrians is allowed to resume, allowing for individual documentation and enhanced protection.
2. Safety, Protection and Access to Justice: Barrier to accessing legal remedies and documentation are reduced. Persons with special needs (PwSN) exposure to protection risks is mitigated and their needs addressed. The risk of GBV are reduced and GBV survivors have access to timely, safe and quality services and prevention and risk mitigation interventions continue. Children are protected from abuse, neglect, violence and exploitation.

tag.narrative: 1.4 - By 2030, ensure that all men and women, in particular the poor and the vulnerable, have equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to basic services, ownership and control over land and other forms of property, inheritance, natural resources, appropriate new technology and financial services, including microfinance.

1.4 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla män och kvinnor, i synnerhet de fattiga och de utsatta, har lika rätt till ekonomiska resurser, tillgång till grundläggande tjänster, möjlighet att äga och kontrollera mark och andra former av egendom samt tillgång till arv, naturresurser, lämplig ny teknik och finansiella tjänster, inklusive mikrokrediter.

1.5 - By 2030, build the resilience of the poor and those in vulnerable situations and reduce their exposure and vulnerability to climate-related extreme events and other economic, social and environmental shocks and disasters.

1.5 - Till 2030 bygga upp motståndskraften hos de fattiga och människor i utsatta situationer och minska deras utsatthet och sårbarhet för extrema klimatrelaterade händelser och andra ekonomiska, sociala och miljömässiga chocker och katastrofer.
10.7 - Facilitate orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility of people, including through the implementation of planned and well-managed migration policies.
10.7 - Underlätta en ordnad, säker, reglerad och ansvarsfull migration och rörlighet av personer, inklusive genom planerad och väl fungerande migrationspolitik.
16.9 - By 2030, provide legal identity for all, including birth registration.
16.9 - Senast 2030 tillhandahålla juridisk identitet för alla, inklusive födelseregistrering.
5.2 - Avskaffa alla former av våld mot alla kvinnor och flickor i det offentliga och privata rummet, inklusive människohandel, sexuellt utnyttjande och andra typer av exploatering.
5.2 - Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation.
7.1 - By 2030, ensure universal access to affordable, reliable and modern energy services.
7.1 - Senast 2030 säkerställa allmän tillgång till ekonomiskt överkomliga, tillförlitliga och moderna energitjänster.
